```bash
from pathlib import Path

        parts = text.split('---', 2)

    else:
        fm, body = '', text

            counts[f]+=1

            c = line.strip().lstrip('- ').strip()
            cats[c] = cats.get(c,0)+1
    body_stripped = body.strip()
    if len(body_stripped) < 40:
        empty_body += 1
    dm = re.search(r'^description:\s*[>|]?\s*(.+)$', fm, re.M)
    if dm and len(dm.group(1).strip()) < 40:
        short_desc += 1
print('field_counts', counts)
print('categories', dict(sorted(cats.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1])))
print('near_empty_body', empty_body)
print('short_description_lines', short_desc)
# draft count
drafts = sum(1 for p in notes if re.search(r'^draft:\s*true', p.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'), re.M))
print('draft_true', drafts)
```

```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re, collections
notes = [p for p in Path('content/english/notes').glob('*.md') if p.name != '_index.md']
# categories can be inline ["A"] or list
cats = collections.Counter()
tags = collections.Counter()
for p in notes:
    text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
    fm = text.split('---', 2)[1] if text.startswith('---') else ''
    for key, counter in [('categories', cats), ('tags', tags)]:
        m = re.search(rf'^{key}:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]', fm, re.M)
        if m:
            for item in re.findall(r'"([^"]+)"|\'([^\']+)\'', m.group(1)):
                counter[item[0] or item[1]] += 1
            continue
        m = re.search(rf'^{key}:\s*\n((?:\s+-\s+.+\n)+)', fm, re.M)
        if m:
            for line in m.group(1).strip().splitlines():
                counter[line.strip().lstrip('- ').strip().strip('"\'')] += 1
print('TOP CATEGORIES')
for k,v in cats.most_common(20):
    print(f'  {v:4d}  {k}')
print('TOP TAGS')
for k,v in tags.most_common(15):
    print(f'  {v:4d}  {k}')
# sample a few notes for quality smell
samples = ['capture.md','rollback-principle.md','abide-in-me.md','law-of-the-lid.md','getting-things-done.md']
for s in samples:
    p = Path('content/english/notes')/s
    if not p.exists():
        print('missing', s); continue
    text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    fm = text.split('---', 2)[1]
    title = re.search(r'^title:\s*"?(.*?)"?\s*$', fm, re.M)
    desc = re.search(r'^description:\s*"?(.*?)"?\s*$', fm, re.M)
    kc = re.search(r'^key_concept:\s*[>|]?\s*(.*?)(?=\n\w|\nexamples:|\nshareable)', fm, re.S)
    print('\n===', s, '===')
    print('title:', title.group(1) if title else None)
    print('desc:', (desc.group(1)[:120] if desc else None))
    print('kc_start:', (kc.group(1).strip()[:160].replace('\n',' | ') if kc else None))
PY
```

**Should you treat the whole notes garden as healthy and leave it, or run a real quality pass?**

### White / First Principles

~338 published notes (`draft: false`), frontmatter-first by design (~322 near-empty bodies). Categories skew Faith (116), Leadership (94), Productivity (89); Thinking/Tips are thin. Coverage is high: description + key_concept on all; examples ~317; relationships ~328; flashcards on ~296. `pnpm garden:health` currently fails: unsorted/duplicate `relationships` concentrated in the Maxwell-law cluster, plus 10 unlinked mentions (mostly "Leadership"). Zero broken wikilinks, orphans, or dead ends. Unknown without reading: voice drift, Free Grace compliance on faith notes, whether leadership notes are Maxwell mirrors or JoRap claims, and whether thin categories are intentional.

### Red / Instinct

This is a filled warehouse, not a living garden. Impressive count, sticky lint debt, and a faith/leadership pile that will look like a syllabus to outsiders. Feels proud of volume and under-touched on taste.

### Black / Contrarian

Calling this "reviewed" by counting frontmatter fields is self-deception. Health is red on mechanical grounds alone - duplicate and unsorted relationships across the law notes mean the sync/normalize path was skipped or half-applied. Unlinked "Leadership" spam is the same class of unfinished polish. Worse: a six-hats pass on "all notes" cannot actually judge 338 claims; if you claim you did, you laundered volume into quality. The category skew is a product risk - Faith + Leadership dominate; a stranger landing on /notes/ may read Maxwell + sermon outline, not JoRap. Meta notes without examples/relationships (`maps-of-content`, `graph`, `issues`, etc.) are fine as tools, but 21 missing-examples notes include content MOCs that should carry the shape. Flashcard density without a voice audit risks textbook backs. Do not celebrate "0 broken links" while lint:garden fails - the garden is not ship-clean.

### Yellow / Expansionist

If you treat this as a pressure-test of the *system*, not a line-by-line rewrite, the upside is huge: one health pass unblocks CI-ish confidence; sorting relationships is mostly scriptable; the atomic shape (levels, examples, shareable_thought, cards) is already a rare public PKM. Faith + Eternal Principles + leadership failure-modes form a coherent personal stack nobody else publishes this way.             leftclose=text.rfind(']]',0,start)
```bash
            if left>leftclose and right!=-1:
                continue  # inside wikilink
            # skip yaml tags/categories lines roughly
            line=text.rfind('\n',0,start)+1
            linestr=text[line:text.find('\n',start)]
            if linestr.strip().startswith('tags:') or linestr.strip().startswith('categories:') or 'tags:' in linestr[:20]:
                continue
            if 'categories:' in linestr:
                continue
            # meta_title with Leadership in compound
            print(f'  {n!r} @ approx line {text[:start].count(chr(10))+1}: {linestr.strip()[:100]}')
PY

```

```bash
from pathlib import Path
import re, yaml, collections
N = Path('content/english/notes')
laws = sorted(p for p in N.glob('law-of-*.md'))
partners = ['activity-without-accomplishment','blind-leadership-calls','climb-without-cost',
'demanding-unearned-respect','do-as-i-say','fighting-dead-momentum','followers-without-leaders',
'hand-before-heart','hoarding-all-power','leading-by-subtraction','low-leadership-lid',
'no-successor-left','right-move-wrong-time','settling-for-loss','skipped-daily-process',
'steering-without-chart','title-without-influence','toxic-magnet-pull','trust-already-cracked',
'vision-without-trust','weak-inner-circle']
partner_paths=[N/f'{s}.md' for s in partners]
print(f'laws={len(laws)} partners={len(partner_paths)}')

def fm_of(p):
    t=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    return yaml.safe_load(t.split('---',2)[1]) or {}

# Template detection: repeated sentences across the cluster
sent_counter=collections.Counter()
opener=collections.Counter()
for p in laws+partner_paths:
    fm=fm_of(p)
    kc=fm.get('key_concept') or ''
    for line in str(kc).splitlines():
        line=line.strip().lstrip('- ').strip()
        if len(line)>20:
```

```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import yaml, re
N=Path('content/english/notes')
partners = ['activity-without-accomplishment','blind-leadership-calls','climb-without-cost',
'demanding-unearned-respect','do-as-i-say','fighting-dead-momentum','followers-without-leaders',
'hand-before-heart','hoarding-all-power','leading-by-subtraction','low-leadership-lid',
'no-successor-left','right-move-wrong-time','settling-for-loss','skipped-daily-process',
'steering-without-chart','title-without-influence','toxic-magnet-pull','trust-already-cracked',
'vision-without-trust','weak-inner-circle']
BOIL1='you can violate the law and pay'
BOIL2='violation partner, not a second law lesson'
risky=[]
for s in partners:
    fm=yaml.safe_load((N/f'{s}.md').read_text().split('---',2)[1])
    sh=' || '.join(fm.get('shareable_thought') or [])
    if BOIL1 in sh or BOIL2 in sh: risky.append(s)
    # does relationships carry both hub and the law?
    rels=[r['wikilink'] for r in (fm.get('relationships') or [])]
    kc=str(fm.get('key_concept',''))
    laws_in_kc=set(re.findall(r'\[\[(Law of [^\]]+)\]\]',kc))
    laws_in_rel=set(x.strip('[]') for x in rels)
    print(f'{s:32s} hub_in_rel={"[[21 Laws of Leadership in the Bible]]" in rels} laws_kc_not_in_rel={laws_in_kc-laws_in_rel}')
print('\nshareable drawing from boilerplate:', risky)

# Hub inbound: who links [[21 Laws of Leadership in the Bible]] and where
hub=0; only_kc=[]
for p in N.glob('*.md'):
    t=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    if '[[21 Laws of Leadership in the Bible]]' not in t: continue
    fm=yaml.safe_load(t.split('---',2)[1]) or {}
    rels=[r.get('wikilink') for r in (fm.get('relationships') or []) if isinstance(r,dict)]
    hub+=1
    if '[[21 Laws of Leadership in the Bible]]' not in rels:
        only_kc.append(p.stem)
print(f'\nnotes linking hub: {hub}; hub link ONLY in key_concept (not relationships): {only_kc}')
```

```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import yaml, re, collections
N=Path('content/english/notes')
partners = ['activity-without-accomplishment','blind-leadership-calls','climb-without-cost',
'demanding-unearned-respect','do-as-i-say','fighting-dead-momentum','followers-without-leaders',
'hand-before-heart','hoarding-all-power','leading-by-subtraction','low-leadership-lid',
'no-successor-left','right-move-wrong-time','settling-for-loss','skipped-daily-process',
'steering-without-chart','title-without-influence','toxic-magnet-pull','trust-already-cracked',
'vision-without-trust','weak-inner-circle']
c=collections.Counter(); bad=[]
for s in partners:
    t=(N/f'{s}.md').read_text()
    fm=yaml.safe_load(t.split('---',2)[1])
    kc=str(fm.get('key_concept',''))
    if 'cannot repeal it' in kc or 'violation partner' in kc: bad.append(s)
    rels=[r['wikilink'] for r in (fm.get('relationships') or [])]
    if '[[21 Laws of Leadership in the Bible]]' not in rels: bad.append(f'{s}:NOHUB')
    for line in kc.splitlines():
        line=line.strip().lstrip('- ').strip()
        if len(line)>20: c[re.sub(r'\[\[[^\]]+\]\]','[[X]]',line)]+=1
print('leftover boilerplate / missing hub:', bad or 'none')
dups=[(v,k) for k,v in c.items() if v>=3]
print('key_concept lines repeated 3+ times:', dups or 'none')
PY
```

```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import yaml, collections
N=Path('content/english/notes')
notes=[p for p in N.glob('*.md') if p.name!='_index.md']
op=collections.Counter()
for p in notes:
    fm=yaml.safe_load(p.read_text().split('---',2)[1]) or {}
    for i in (1,2,3,5):
        v=str(fm.get(f'level_{i}') or '')
        if v: op[(i,' '.join(v.split()[:2]).rstrip(',.'))]+=1
print('GARDEN-WIDE level openers (>=8):')
for (i,o),c in op.most_common(25):
    if c>=8: print(f'  level_{i}  {c:3d}x  "{o}..."')
PY
```
